principle: An unresolved MWM policy is a configuration hook, not a model default.

hooks.name: apa_edge_case_adoption
hooks.question: Which APA edge cases does MWM adopt when chapter guidance is silent?
hooks.default_behavior: ESCALATE affected record; do not claim APA certainty

hooks.name: dataset_persistent_identifier_fallbacks
hooks.question: Which persistent-identifier fallbacks satisfy MWM for datasets?
hooks.default_behavior: BLOCK or ESCALATE when a required dataset identifier is absent; never infer an identifier

hooks.name: metadata_source_of_record
hooks.question: Which source wins when official source material and providers disagree on a material field?
hooks.default_behavior: Preserve competing values and ESCALATE; provider data cannot silently win

hooks.name: access_date_policy
hooks.question: When are retrieval/access dates required for web sources?
hooks.default_behavior: Do not add or remove an access date automatically; FLAG or ESCALATE affected records

hooks.name: source_relation_representation
hooks.question: How should versions, corrections, translations, preprints, and related works be represented in the exchange format?
hooks.default_behavior: Preserve distinct source records and typed relations; do not merge

hooks.name: auto_fix_whitelist
hooks.question: Which deterministic, reversible, identity-preserving transformations may be applied automatically?
hooks.default_behavior: AUTO_FIX is disabled unless the active run profile enables the named transform; otherwise SUGGEST or FLAG

hooks.name: notes_and_endnotes_scope
hooks.question: How are notes and endnotes treated across manuscript types?
hooks.default_behavior: Require scope in the run manifest; if omitted, return partial coverage and not_ready for release

hooks.name: software_reference_policy
hooks.question: Which software release, version, creator, and identifier fields are required by MWM?
hooks.default_behavior: Preserve software identity uncertainty and ESCALATE when version or identifier is material and missing

hooks.name: provider_match_threshold
hooks.question: What evidence threshold permits accepting a probable Crossref/DataCite or other provider match?
hooks.default_behavior: Provider match remains a candidate; no material correction or closure without decisive evidence
